name: agent-sessions-search
title: Agent Sessions
description: Search and resume Claude Code and Codex sessions. Full-text search over every historical transcript, PR-aware ranking, one keystroke to resume in your terminal or desktop app. Everything stays local.
author: tom_esterez

commands.name: search-sessions
commands.title: Search Agent Sessions
commands.subtitle: Claude Code / Codex
commands.description: Search all Claude Code and Codex sessions by PR, issue, branch, file or text and resume them.

commands.name: refresh-index
commands.title: Refresh Sessions Index
commands.description: Incrementally index new or changed sessions in the background.

commands.name: rebuild-index
commands.title: Rebuild Sessions Index
commands.description: Drop the local search index and rebuild it from scratch.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal
preferences.description: Terminal used to resume sessions from the command line.

preferences.name: defaultResumeTarget
preferences.title: Default Resume Action
preferences.description: What Enter does. Auto opens desktop-created sessions in the desktop app and CLI sessions in the terminal.

preferences.name: claudeCommand
preferences.title: Claude CLI Command
preferences.description: Command used to resume Claude Code sessions in the terminal.

preferences.name: codexCommand
preferences.title: Codex CLI Command
preferences.description: Command used to resume Codex sessions in the terminal.

preferences.name: linearWorkspace
preferences.title: Linear Workspace
preferences.description: Workspace slug used for issue links (linear.app/<workspace>/issue/KEY). Detected from URLs in your sessions when empty.

scripts.build: npm run build:worker && ray build -e dist
